adaptationNotes: Selected files only, pinned to commit a40c7a0. Generators were ported to float math with time wrapped at the true period: LightGrid -> shaders/light-grid, CircleWaveTransformation -> shaders/sonar-pulse. Sinebow, Transition/CircleWave, Water, Infrared and Shimmer were reduced to snippets (sinebow-lines, dot-curtain, sine-warp, color-ramps). SwiftUI points become height-relative units; input color/alpha handling is dropped.
name: Inferno

origin.author: Paul Hudson and other authors (credits in original LICENSE)

requirements: SwiftUI [[stitchable]] colorEffect, distortionEffect or layerEffect signature
position in points with y down; size passed as a uniform
most effects sample the layer or input color; only generators port as backgrounds
summary: Paul Hudson's MIT SwiftUI shader collection; LightGrid and CircleWave became catalog scenes, other techniques became snippets.
